meta.titulo: Maré Alta · Seafood restaurant in Olhão, Algarve
meta.descricao: Seafood restaurant in Olhão, by the Ria Formosa. Fresh shellfish, grilled fish and cataplanas. Book a table on WhatsApp.
nav.label: Main
hero.titulo: Fresh from the ria, to your table in Olhão
hero.texto: Clams, oysters and fish that arrive every morning from the market next door. Algarve cooking, unhurried, with a view of the lagoon.
sobre.img_alt: Clam cataplana straight off the stove
sobre.titulo: One family, one lagoon and the catch of the day
sobre.p1: Maré Alta opened in 1987, a short walk from Olhão's markets. It started as a fishermen's tavern and is still run by the same family.
sobre.p2: Every morning we pick our shellfish and fish at the auction. If it isn't fresh, it doesn't get into the kitchen, so the menu changes with the tide and the season.
sobre.d1_p: Shellfish and fish bought every morning.
sobre.d2_p: Sunsets looking out to Armona and Culatra islands.
sobre.d3_p: Cataplana, razor clam rice and clam xerém (corn porridge).
